falseFriends.actual: Use 'בפועל' (be-fo'al) or 'ממשי' (mamashi), not 'אקטואלי' (which means 'current/topical' from German/Yiddish)
falseFriends.available: Use 'זמין' (zamin) for equipment availability; 'פנוי' (panui) means free/unoccupied (for people/rooms)
falseFriends.setup: Use 'הכנה' (preparation) or 'החלפת מוצר' (product changeover), not 'סטאפ' (software installation in Israeli hi-tech)
falseFriends.line: Use 'קו ייצור' (production line) — bare 'קו' alone is ambiguous (geometric/queue/phone line)
falseFriends.idle: Use 'סרק' (serak, idle running) or 'המתנה' (standby/waiting), not 'עצלן' (atslan, lazy — pejorative)
falseFriends.efficiency_vs_effectiveness: 'יעילות' covers both efficiency and effectiveness — in OEE context, 'יעילות כוללת' is established and correct

grammarNotes.rtlScript: RTL Hebrew script; Latin acronyms (OEE, KPI, MTTR) maintain LTR via Unicode BiDi. 'ה-OEE' connects Hebrew article to Latin acronym with hyphen.
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: Two genders. 'זמינות גבוהה' (high availability, f+f). 'ביצועים גבוהים' (high performance, m.pl). Mismatched gender immediately visible to native speakers.
grammarNotes.constructState: Compound nouns via construct state (סמיכות): 'זמן מחזור' (cycle time), 'סיבת עצירה' (stop reason). Preferred over 'של' for technical terms.
grammarNotes.noNiqqud: Professional Hebrew does NOT use niqqud (vowel marks). Adding niqqud looks patronizing.
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Decimal: period (.). Thousands: comma (,). '85%' (no space). Israel follows Anglo-American convention. Numbers in Arabic numerals, never Hebrew numerals.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In construct state (סמיכות) compounds, the modifier (סומך) stays SINGULAR while the head noun (נסמך) takes plural. 'סיבות אובדן מהירות' (reasons [pl.construct] + loss [sg] + speed) is correctly formed. No compound pluralization issue — correct by construct state rules.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE (Latin) universal in Israeli manufacturing. Use 'מדד ה-OEE' in Hebrew text. Full: 'יעילות כוללת של הציוד' for tooltips/docs only.

usagePattern.documentation: OEE (יעילות כוללת של הציוד) on first mention

industryContext.dominantSectors: Semiconductors (Intel, Tower), medical devices, pharmaceuticals (Teva), defense/aerospace (IAI, Elbit), food & beverage
industryContext.dominantVendors: Contel Technologies/Trunovate (leading Israeli MES), SAP (via Malam Team), Matics, Priority Software

commonMistakes: Using full Hebrew term 'יעילות כוללת של הציוד' in UI labels instead of 'OEE'
Gender agreement errors: 'זמינות גבוה' (wrong) vs 'זמינות גבוהה' (correct) — f noun needs f adjective
Using 'פרפורמנס' (entertainment) instead of 'ביצועים' for manufacturing performance
Using 'אקטואלי' (current/topical) instead of 'בפועל' for actual/measured values
Incorrect scrap terminology: 'סיבת ברק' means 'lightning reason' — should be 'סיבת פסולת' or 'סיבת פחת'
Missing hyphen in 'ה-OEE' — should connect Hebrew definite article to Latin acronym
Adding niqqud to professional manufacturing text
notes: OEE (Latin) universal in Israeli manufacturing. Hebrew is typically SHORTER than English (P95 1.25x). Unicode BiDi handles RTL/LTR mixing. Formal pronouns but Hebrew lacks Sie/vous distinction. Full Hebrew term available for expansion in tooltips.
